Cancelling/rescheduling a collective booking created by this PR leaves the non-first hosts' old calendar events orphaned on their calendars, since only one old event is deleted while createAllCalendarEvents created one per host.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, `calendarReference` was changed from a single reference to an array via `.filter(...)` and is processed in a loop, but the merge cleanup path still does `const oldCalendarEvent = booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"));` when `newBookingId` is present. Since this PR now creates/handles multiple calendar references (e.g., `createAllCalendarEvents` loops `event.destinationCalendar` and creates events per destination), deleting only the first old calendar reference during a merge can leave other old calendar events orphaned.
